title: Work Agents: Systems, Capabilities, and Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.35845v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As foundation models evolve from information generation to digital work execution, agents are increasingly capable of completing complex tasks across tools, applications, and workflows. However, existing research lacks a unified perspective on how agents reliably accomplish delegated work. To address this gap, we present a work-centric, system-level perspective that views work agents as systems combining foundation models and runtime harnesses to execute tasks in stateful workspaces and deliver verifiable outcomes. We introduce two complementary dimensions, work persistence and work openness, to characterize working conditions, and classify digital work into five forms according to task scope and organization. Building on this framework, we identify five core capability families required for reliable work execution and examine approaches to model optimization, harness optimization, and their joint optimization. translated_title: 工作智能体：系统、能力与优化
translated_abstract: 随着基础模型从信息生成演进到数字工作执行，智能体越来越有能力完成跨工具、应用和工作流的复杂任务。然而，现有研究缺乏关于智能体如何可靠地完成受委托工作的统一视角。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一个以工作为中心的系统级视角，将工作智能体视为由基础模型和运行时框架组合而成的系统，它们在有状态的工作空间中执行任务并交付可验证的结果。我们引入两个互补的维度——工作持久性和工作开放性——来刻画工作条件，并根据任务范围和组织方式将数字工作划分为五种形式。基于这一框架，我们识别出可靠工作执行所需的五大核心能力族，并研究了模型优化、运行时框架优化以及两者联合优化的方法。我们进一步分析了现有（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一个以工作为中心的系统级新视角，将工作智能体视为基础模型与运行时框架相结合的系统，引入工作持久性与工作开放性两个维度刻画工作条件，将数字工作分为五种形式，并识别出可靠工作执行所需的五大核心能力族及模型优化、框架优化与联合优化的方法。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a work-centric, system-level perspective that views work agents as systems combining foundation models and runtime harnesses, introducing the dimensions of work persistence and work openness, classifying digital work into five forms, and identifying five core capability families for reliable work execution along with approaches to model optimization, harness optimization, and their joint optimization.
